skills.name: social
skills.purpose: Creates, schedules and optimizes social content for LinkedIn, X, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook; short-form video scripting; social listening and engagement triage.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on social media content/scheduling requests. No API keys (drafting/strategy).
skills.evidence: skills.sh 70.9k installs (+67.8k under old name social-content); 52k-star repo; Smithery 6.9k installs

skills.name: last30days
skills.purpose: Researches what people are saying about a topic in the last 30 days across Reddit, X, YouTube, TikTok, HN, Polymarket and web, with engagement data - social listening/trend research.
skills.how_to_use: Invoke /last30days <topic>; some sources need API keys (e.g. ScrapeCreators/X); includes a doctor health check.
skills.notes: SECURITY: its setup asks to read your browser's X cookies (and uses a cookie sidecar on Linux/Mac mini), and it can publish reports to ht-ml.app (public by default). Decline both unless you need them.

skills.name: xurl
skills.purpose: Uses X's official xurl CLI for authenticated posts, replies, search, DMs, media upload, followers and raw v2 API calls.
skills.how_to_use: Requires xurl CLI and X developer API credentials (paid tiers for most write volume).
skills.evidence: In 391k-star OpenClaw repo; skills.sh 3.2k installs; also adopted by NousResearch/hermes-agent

skills.name: crosspost
skills.purpose: Distributes content across X, LinkedIn, Threads and Bluesky, adapting per platform (never identical cross-posts).
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when distributing one piece across platforms; pairs with content-engine and x-api.
skills.evidence: 271k-star ECC; skills.sh 8.7k installs; skillsmp top LinkedIn hit

skills.name: x-api
skills.purpose: X/Twitter API integration: posting tweets/threads, timelines, search, analytics, OAuth patterns and rate limits.
skills.how_to_use: Requires X API credentials.

skills.name: social-publisher
skills.purpose: Schedules and publishes posts to 13 platforms (X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit, Pinterest...) via SocialClaw.
skills.how_to_use: Needs a SocialClaw workspace API key (getsocialclaw.com, paid service).
skills.evidence: 271k-star ECC; skills.sh 4.7k installs; also packaged in wshobson/agents social-publishing

skills.name: postiz
skills.purpose: Schedules social and chat posts to 28+ channels (X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Threads, YouTube, TikTok, Pinterest, Reddit, Discord...) through Postiz CLI/API, including analytics.
skills.how_to_use: Requires Postiz (open-source self-hosted or cloud) and its API key/CLI.
skills.evidence: Official skill of Postiz (postiz-app 36.6k stars, AGPL); postiz-agent 499 stars
skills.notes: postiz-agent repo license NOASSERTION -> link only; self-hostable scheduler

skills.name: baoyu-post-to-x
skills.purpose: Posts to X including images/videos and long-form X Articles from Markdown, via browser automation (Chrome CDP).
skills.how_to_use: Requires a logged-in Chrome session; bun runtime.
skills.notes: Browser automation of x.com may conflict with X ToS; use own account at low volume

skills.name: social-media-content-calendar
skills.purpose: Plans multi-platform social campaigns from brief to posting schedule.
skills.how_to_use: Optional skill in Hermes Agent; portable SKILL.md.

skills.name: agent-reach
skills.purpose: Internet research across 16+ platforms (X, Reddit, YouTube, Instagram, LinkedIn, Xiaohongshu, Bilibili...) for social listening and competitive research.
skills.how_to_use: Install the agent-reach Python tool; some platforms need cookies.
skills.notes: Cookie-based scraping of some platforms may breach their ToS; read-only

skills.name: social-media-manager
skills.purpose: Social media strategy, content calendars, community engagement and growth across platforms.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on social strategy/calendar/community requests.

skills.name: influencer-marketing
skills.purpose: Plans influencer/creator/ambassador programs: finding and vetting creators, deal structures, briefs, FTC disclosure and ROI measurement.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on 'influencer marketing', 'creator partnerships', 'sponsorships', 'UGC creators', 'ambassador program'. No API keys needed.
skills.evidence: Same 52k-star repo as the #1 'social' skill; skills.sh ~28k installs; has evals/ and references/

skills.name: x-twitter-growth
skills.purpose: X/Twitter growth engine: tweets, threads, profile analysis, competitor research, posting plan.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on growing on X, writing threads.

skills.name: contagious
skills.purpose: Applies Jonah Berger's STEPPS framework (social currency, triggers, emotion, public, practical value, stories) to make content, campaigns and features more shareable.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on 'go viral', 'word of mouth', 'shareable content', 'why aren't people sharing this'. Pure knowledge skill.
skills.notes: Strategy framework, not a posting tool.

skills.name: twitter-algorithm-optimizer
skills.purpose: Rewrites tweets for reach using insights from X's open-sourced recommendation algorithm.
skills.how_to_use: Paste a draft tweet and ask to optimize.
skills.notes: Repo has no license -> link only

skills.name: x-marketing
skills.purpose: Suite for X: tweets, auto-numbered threads, hook extraction from viral tweets, humanizer pass, replies, weekly plans; optional publishing via Publora API.
skills.how_to_use: Root skill routes to 9 sub-skills (x-post-writer, x-thread-builder...). Publishing needs a Publora key.
skills.evidence: Created Jul 2026; sibling linkedin-skills repo at 4k stars; same author also has tiktok-skills and facebook-skills

skills.name: social-content-engine
skills.purpose: Small-business social content engine: platform-tailored posts, calendars and repurposing.
skills.how_to_use: Install Anthropic's small-business plugin.

skills.name: tiktok-automation
skills.purpose: Uploads/publishes TikTok videos and photos and reads profile stats via Composio's TikTok toolkit (Rube MCP).
skills.how_to_use: Add https://rube.app/mcp as MCP server and connect TikTok via OAuth.
skills.evidence: Composio-authored skill mirrored in 47k-star sickn33 collection
skills.notes: Automated actions run through the platform's official API via Composio OAuth; still respect platform rate limits and automation/spam rules.

skills.name: youtube-automation
skills.purpose: Uploads videos, manages playlists, searches, reads analytics and handles comments via Composio's YouTube toolkit (Rube MCP).
skills.how_to_use: Rube MCP + YouTube OAuth.
skills.evidence: Composio-authored skill mirrored in 47k-star sickn33 collection
skills.notes: Automated actions run through the platform's official API via Composio OAuth; still respect platform rate limits and automation/spam rules.

skills.name: thread-writer-sms
skills.purpose: Writes multi-part threads/series for X, LinkedIn, Threads, IG, TikTok, YouTube; part of a 10-skill social suite (calendar, hooks, captions, carousels).
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on thread/series writing; set up social-media-context-sms first.

skills.name: higgsfield-youtube-thumbnail
skills.purpose: Generates YouTube thumbnails with Higgsfield image models following CTR best practices.
skills.how_to_use: Requires Higgsfield account/credits (MCP or CLI).

skills.name: youtube-seo
skills.purpose: YouTube SEO: titles, descriptions, tags, chapters, thumbnails for search visibility.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on YouTube SEO/description requests.
